name: compiler_binding_at
description: Look up compiler bindings at an exact raw UTF8 token-start byte offset (including BOM). Omit context_id to list recorded contexts; selecting one requires its raw_sha256. Compiler evidence is historical and project-specific. Optional implementation_facts on method declarations identify compiler interface correspondence via implementation_symbols, not runtime dispatch. Optional domain_facts describe compile-time framework observations, not runtime delivery, service resolution, or database activity.

name: compiler_contract_context
description: Retrieve a compact task context for an exact contract: recorded framework observations grouped by captured project and source owner, plus contract source definitions, in one immutable session. Symbol descriptors occur once in symbols; source hashes/spans preserve navigation. Omit context_ids to discover fact and definition-only contexts, then explicitly select compatible variants (no two contexts of one repo/project). Evidence and definition limits default80/20, must each be positive and sum to at most100; separate truncation flags and a shared10000-row/2MiB materialization budget apply. No runtime activation/delivery/dependency-closure inference; missing evidence is not absence.

name: compiler_contract_impact
description: Find recorded compile-time framework evidence for an exact domain target's symbol.id (not the bound framework API method ID). Omit context_ids to discover bounded choices, then explicitly select up to 32 contexts; incompatible variants of a repository/project cannot be combined. Paths link the contract to a matched framework fact and recorded source/owner, preserving descriptors, raw source hashes and context. The 2 MiB index materialization budget is not a serialized response-size ceiling: path fields repeat evidence. Capture-only supported APIs exclude private wrappers and unsupported patterns; missing evidence is not dependency absence. No runtime publisher-consumer links, delivery, service activation or database activity are inferred.

name: compiler_contract_paths
description: Find bounded candidate static wrapper paths to an exact message contract's direct publishers. Requires explicit context_ids; no two variants of one repo/project. At most one caller step, optionally through a recorded interface implementation. No runtime dispatch, delivery, DI resolution, recursion, or synthetic publisher facts. limit1..100 counts seeds and repeated evidence across paths; at most20 seeds,10000 inspected rows,2MiB materialization. Separate seed/path truncation.

name: compiler_definitions
description: Return recorded compiler declaration variants for a qualified symbol; optional repo/context filters. Optional implementation_facts link source method declarations to compiler-verified interface members via implementation_symbols; this is historical compiler evidence, not runtime dispatch or reverse implementation discovery.

name: compiler_implementations
description: Discover captured source implementations of an exact interface method symbol_id. Omit context_ids for bounded context choices, then explicitly select up to 32 contexts; variants of one repository/project cannot be combined. Each result anchors a method declaration with compiler correspondence facts and deduplicated symbols; implementation_fact_index identifies the queried interface fact. The compiler subset excludes generic, inherited, default and static interface implementation mappings. Results are compile-time evidence, not runtime dispatch. Limits: 100 results, 10000 posting rows, 2 MiB index materialization (not a serialized response-size ceiling).

name: file_tree
description: List files in an indexed repository, optionally filtered by directory path prefix.

prefix.description: Path prefix filter (e.g. 'src/' to list only files under src/).

name: graph_neighbors
description: Return ALL graph edges (any type) connected to a symbol — the full unfiltered neighborhood. Use trace_* tools when you know the edge type; use this for orientation.

min_confidence.description: Minimum edge confidence included before traversal (default Pattern).

name: graph_schema
description: Describe the loaded graph snapshot: generation, corpus fingerprint, build ID, node kind counts, edge type counts, and totals. Use its identity fields for downstream cache keys.

name: impact_analysis
description: Return the transitive closure of graph dependents for exactly one file or symbol, up to the requested depth.

file.description: Absolute, repo-relative, or suffix file path. Supply exactly one of file or symbol.

min_confidence.description: Minimum edge confidence included before traversal (default Pattern).

symbol.description: Exact symbol name. Supply exactly one of file or symbol.

name: list_clusters
description: Page precomputed graph-community summaries, or page members of one cluster by cluster_id. Communities are generation-bound and built only during graph build/refresh.

cluster_id.description: Optional cluster to inspect; omit for summaries.

name: list_repos
description: List all indexed repositories in the corpus with file counts. Use this first to discover what code is available.

filter.description: Optional substring filter on repository names (case-insensitive).

name: list_symbols
description: Search symbols across the corpus by kind, name, and/or repository. At least one filter is required. Returns at most 200 results.

kind.description: Filter by symbol kind (e.g. Type, Method, Function, Class, Interface). Case-insensitive.

name: read_source
description: Read a source file's content from the indexed corpus by repository and path. Supports partial reads via start_line/end_line.

end_line.description: Optional inclusive final line; omitted reads to the file or tool limit.

path.description: Relative file path within the repository. If not an exact match, the tool falls back to suffix matching (e.g. 'OrderService.cs' finds 'src/Services/OrderService.cs').

repo.description: Repository name (as returned by list_repos). Omit to search all repos.

name: search_context
description: Search the indexed code corpus and return ranked, deduplicated, token-budgeted context blocks for an LLM agent, each annotated with its code-graph neighborhood (callers, callees, consumers, publishers, dependencies, semantic siblings).

format.description: Compatibility presentation option for the text fallback. structuredContent is always returned with per-block provenance.

graph_depth.description: Graph annotation radius in hops (optional, default 1). Each result block carries a "neighbors" field with the callers, callees, consumers, publishers, dependencies, and semantic siblings of the symbols it contains — no second graph tool call needed. 0 disables the annotation.

language.description: Canonical language selected by file extension.

min_confidence.description: Minimum graph-edge confidence included in annotations (optional, default Pattern). Edges below the floor are excluded before traversal.

path_prefix.description: Literal repository-relative path prefix on directory boundaries; no globs.

token_budget.description: Maximum tokens for the returned context (optional).

top_k.description: Maximum number of ranked results to draw blocks from (optional).

name: trace_calls
description: Trace callers and callees of a symbol through confidence-scored call edges from the mmap graph.

min_confidence.description: Minimum edge confidence included before traversal (default Pattern).

name: trace_consumers
description: Return every publisher and consumer connected to an event or queue name in the mmap graph.

min_confidence.description: Minimum edge confidence included before traversal (default Pattern).

name.description: Exact event or queue symbol name.

name: trace_hierarchy
description: Return the type hierarchy for a type symbol: supertypes (extends/implements), subtypes, contained methods, and DI injection bindings.

min_confidence.description: Minimum edge confidence included before traversal (default Pattern).

name: trace_queries
description: Return the EF/database query relationships for a symbol: what entities a method queries and what code touches an entity.

min_confidence.description: Minimum edge confidence included before traversal (default Pattern).

symbol.description: Exact symbol name (method or entity type) to trace.

name: trace_renders
description: Return the component rendering relationships for a symbol: what child components a parent renders and what parents render a child.

min_confidence.description: Minimum edge confidence included before traversal (default Pattern).
